items.html: Know that those spirits (Ruchin) mentioned in the seven palaces (Heichalot) of Parashat Pekudei, where in each and every palace there is one spirit — they are in the aspect of the spirits that are in Beria. And there is also an aspect of souls (Nefashin) and an aspect of garments, and likewise in Yetzira and Assiya. However, those in Parashat Pekudei are the aspect of the spirits of Beria. And see Parashat Mishpatim, page 23, side B, and page 40. And all the above is in the matter of the Nukva of ZA of ABYA. And just as all these aspects exist in the Nukva of ZA, so do all these aspects exist in Arich Anpin, in Aba and Ima, and in ZA, for they spread through the four worlds ABYA in the manner that was explained with regard to the Nukva. However, I was not worthy to hear but the aspect of ZON alone.
